snippet.title: Football - MAGNAVOX ODYSSEY (1972)
snippet.description:
odySim v0.1e simulator

Card # 3,4  Magnavox Odyssey
number of players  2 players (Versus)
Designer: Ralph Baer.
Football, Sports

Description from: http://www.old-computers.com
Football for the Magnavox Odyssey is, of course, the first American Football video game ever. Two players use a combination of on-screen movement, dice, and play cards to simulate a game of football; kickoff, passing, and punting plays use Card #3 while running plays use Card #4

Football is more of a "football abstraction". It's as if the game is asking you to pretend that you are playing a football simulation. It includes an overlay, a game board, about 40 cards, a football marker, and a yardage marker and utilizes no less than three of the pack-in Odyssey carts. You use the included gameboard to keep track of where the ball is. There's a table printed on the board to help you figure out the yardage results of plays based on cards drawn and dice rolled. This game is 95% boardgame and 5% video game. I actually thought that would be part of its charm.

grab the simulator here:
http://odysim.blogspot.mx/
